record.headline: Salesforce changed which extras come bundled with its Sales editions: Core no longer lists Momentum, Max now lists Advanced Momentum, and Momentum is now available for purchase.

record.read: Momentum looks to be moving from a Core inclusion to a separate purchase, with a premium version reserved for the top edition. This is our inference from the wording changes only.

record.headline: Together AI raised the price of Qwen3.7-Max serverless inference by about two thirds on input, cached input and output tokens.
record.who: Anyone calling Qwen3.7-Max through Together AI serverless inference.
record.read: This is the second increase on this model since September, which suggests Together is passing through higher upstream cost or demand-based pricing. The same page also dropped several models and cut the Nemotron 3.5 ASR price.
record.caveat: Together removed several models from the list in the same change, so some customers may need to migrate. A price cut on Nemotron 3.5 ASR ($0.0045 to $0.0015) appears in the same diff but is not covered by this card.
